Alger, 15 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 15, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Crédit Populaire d'Algérie announced on November 15, 2026 the launch of its new international electronic payment solution named CPAzonapay. This service allows Algerian merchants with a website to collect payments made from abroad using Visa and Mastercard cards.
Un outil d'encaissement international po: An international payment collection tool for local businesses
Le Crédit Populaire d'Algérie (CPA) a of: Crédit Populaire d'Algérie (CPA) officially announced the rollout of its CPAzonapay platform on Sunday, November 15, 2026. This electronic payment system is aimed at merchants and businesses owning online sales websites. It allows them to receive payments from abroad using the international Visa and Mastercard bank card networks.
Cette prestation cible en premier lieu l: This service primarily targets players in the tourism, hospitality, air transport, healthcare, telecommunications, education, and distance learning sectors. CPA also targets EdTech companies, crafts, small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as export-oriented structures. The public bank emphasizes the simplification of financial transaction management, the security of the system, and the expansion of the target customer base.
Progression des outils monétiques et sol: Growth of electronic payment tools and banking solutions
Avant le CPA, la Banque de développement: Before CPA, Banque de développement local (BDL) had already positioned itself in this niche by integrating the Visa network in May 2025, followed by Mastercard in décembre 2025 for payments from abroad to Algeria. BDL has recorded over one million euros in transactions since the activation of its offer with Visa.
Parallèlement, l'équipement des commerce: At the same time, the equipping of businesses with electronic payment instruments continues to evolve across the national territory. According to GIE Monétique data, the overall infrastructure has seen an increase in its equipment, although the overall coverage rate still needs to be developed.
Ces initiatives d'encaissement dématéria: These digital payment collection initiatives seek to facilitate the inflow of foreign currency while encouraging the reduction of cash flows and the increase of banking penetration.
Le Crédit Populaire d'Algérie a lancé le: Crédit Populaire d'Algérie launched the CPAzonapay service on November 15, 2026 to accept Visa and Mastercard cards.
La solution permet aux sites e-commerce: The solution enables Algerian e-commerce websites to collect payments made by customers located abroad.
Le parc national de terminaux de paiemen: The national fleet of electronic payment terminals has exceeded 104,000 units, although less than 10% of merchants are equipped.
